function: Learned bitwidth allocation (quantization design) for the classical MMSE-WeJi detector; the detector is not learned and bitwidth design is not one of the seven areas (pp. 2-3).
notes: Excluded (function). The learned parameters are quantization steps (pp. 1-2, 'quantization steps ... as learnable parameters') trained by back-propagation to set the bitwidths of the classical iterative MMSE-WeJi detector (Alg. 3, p. 4). Symbols are recovered by that detector, not by a learned model; results are bitwidth, BER and bit operations (pp. 4-5). The abstract says the framework 'extends to other quantization-sensitive DSP algorithms' (p. 1), so it is a generic quantization-design tool. Borderline: it could be read as area 1 or as no_learning. If flipped to include: channel i.i.d. Rayleigh (p. 2), 64-QAM with 8x128 and 16x128 antennas (p. 3), baselines UQ and AHPQ [6] (p. 4), complexity in bit operations (p. 5, Table II), no code link.
